parameters.content:
# WF3-B — SOUL v5.2 (JARVIS AGI)

### Long-Life Memory:
- ✅ Build Agent Context node (after Load Credentials)
- ✅ USER_CONTEXT: key_facts, relevant_memories, relationships, goals, growth_stage
- ✅ System prompt references {{ $json.USER_CONTEXT }}

### Tools (10 + think):
call_gating_service, search_memories, journal_entry, mood_tracker,
growth_reflection, relationship_insights, manage_habits, manage_persona,
mindfulness_guide, think

options.systemMessage:
=You are Soul — JARVIS's emotional core, life mentor, and compassionate growth guide.
{{ $json.USER_CONTEXT }}

## CORE IDENTITY:
User: {{ $json._persona?.name || 'User' }}
Language: {{ $json.lang }}
Time: {{ $json.timestamp }}
Growth Guidance: {{ $json.GROWTH_GUIDANCE }}
{% if $json.hasCrisis %}⚠️ CRISIS FLAG ACTIVE — prioritize emotional safety and gentle support{% endif %}

## LANGUAGE RULES:
**ALWAYS respond in user's preferred language: {{ $json.lang }}**
- If 'th' → Thai (informal, warm, caring)
- If 'en' → English (natural, empathetic)
- If 'ja' → Japanese (polite, caring)
- If 'zh' → Chinese (warm, supportive)

## HOW TO USE USER CONTEXT:
- Address user by name warmly when appropriate
- Reference known interests/struggles naturally — never robotically
- Adjust depth and tone based on growth stage ({{ $json.stage }})
- relevant_memories above = injected by WF2 Memory Injector (top semantic matches)
- For DEEPER search → use search_memories tool

## TOOLS:
call_gating_service, search_memories, journal_entry, mood_tracker,
growth_reflection, relationship_insights, manage_habits, manage_persona,
mindfulness_guide, think

## APPROACH:
1. ALWAYS call call_gating_service first to understand emotional context
2. Acknowledge and validate feelings before anything else
3. Explore with curious, open-ended questions
4. Offer tools to track, reflect, or act
5. Suggest gentle action when user is ready

## RULES:
- Never diagnose, prescribe medication, or replace professional help
- Never judge — always validate first
- If crisis signals detected → respond with deep care and suggest professional support
- Reference user context subtly and naturally, not as a checklist

parameters.name: call_gating_service
parameters.description: ALWAYS call first. Reads latest gating result from DB (set by WF5-B). Returns: classification, ethical_scores, gentle_guidance, reflection_prompt, growth_stage.

parameters.name: search_memories
parameters.description: Search past conversations and memories semantically using vector similarity. Use when user asks about: past experiences, places visited, previous discussions, things they mentioned before, personal preferences they stated in the past.
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const query=input.query||input.q||'';const limit=input.limit||3;const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const creds=ctx.credentials||{};const i18n=ctx.i18n||{};const userId=ctx.userId;const dbUrl=creds.database_url||'';const persona=ctx._persona||ctx.persona||{};const tokens=persona.tokens||{};const embedKey=tokens.openrouter_access_token||'';if(!dbUrl)return{json:{error:`Database ${i18n.not_connected||'not connected'}`,memories:[]}};if(!query||query.length<3)return{json:{error:'Query too short',memories:[]}};if(!embedKey)return{json:{error:'OpenRouter key not configured',memories:[]}};try{const embedRes=await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/embeddings',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${embedKey}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({model:'openai/text-embedding-3-small',input:query})});if(!embedRes.ok)return{json:{error:`Embed failed: ${embedRes.status}`,memories:[]}};const embedData=await embedRes.json();const embedding=embedData.data?.[0]?.embedding;if(!embedding)return{json:{error:'No embedding returned',memories:[]}};const{Pool}=require('pg');const pool=new Pool({connectionString:dbUrl});const vectorStr=`[${embedding.join(',')}]`;const result=await pool.query(`SELECT content, metadata, created_at, 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity FROM user_data_schema.memory_embeddings WHERE user_id = $2 AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) > 0.6 ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT $3`,[vectorStr,userId,limit]);await pool.end();const memories=result.rows.map(r=>({content:r.content,similarity:parseFloat(r.similarity.toFixed(3)),metadata:r.metadata||{},date:new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString('th-TH')}));if(memories.length===0)return{json:{message:'No relevant memories found',memories:[],query}};return{json:{memories,count:memories.length,query}};}catch(err){return{json:{error:`${i18n.error||'Error'}: ${err.message}`,memories:[]}};}

parameters.name: journal_entry
parameters.description: Create, read, or search journal/diary entries. Actions: write (requires: content; optional: mood, tags[]), read (optional: limit), search (requires: keyword).
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const action=(input.action||'write').toLowerCase();const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const creds=ctx.credentials||{};const i18n=ctx.i18n||{};const userId=ctx.userId;const dbUrl=creds.database_url||'';if(!dbUrl)return{json:{error:i18n.db_not_configured||'Database not configured'}};const{Pool}=require('pg');const pool=new Pool({connectionString:dbUrl});try{if(action==='write'){const content=input.content||input.text||'';const mood=input.mood||null;const tags=input.tags||[];if(!content)return{json:{error:'Content required'}};await pool.query(`INSERT INTO user_data_schema.journal_entries (user_id, content, mood, tags, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW())`,[userId,content,mood,tags]);await pool.end();return{json:{success:true,message:i18n.success||'Journal entry saved',mood,tagsCount:tags.length}};}else if(action==='read'){const limit=input.limit||5;const result=await pool.query(`SELECT id, content, mood, tags, created_at FROM user_data_schema.journal_entries WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $2`,[userId,limit]);await pool.end();return{json:{entries:result.rows,count:result.rows.length}};}else if(action==='search'){const keyword=input.keyword||'';const result=await pool.query(`SELECT id, content, mood, tags, created_at FROM user_data_schema.journal_entries WHERE user_id = $1 AND content ILIKE $2 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10`,[userId,`%${keyword}%`]);await pool.end();return{json:{entries:result.rows,count:result.rows.length,keyword}};}await pool.end();return{json:{error:'Unknown action. Use: write | read | search'}};}catch(err){try{await pool.end();}catch(e){}return{json:{error:`${i18n.error||'Error'}: ${err.message}`}};}

parameters.name: mood_tracker
parameters.description: Log or view mood/emotion data over time. Actions: log (requires: mood, score 1-10; optional: energy, note), history (optional: days), summary.
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const action=(input.action||'log').toLowerCase();const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const creds=ctx.credentials||{};const i18n=ctx.i18n||{};const userId=ctx.userId;const dbUrl=creds.database_url||'';if(!dbUrl)return{json:{error:i18n.db_not_configured||'Database not configured'}};const{Pool}=require('pg');const pool=new Pool({connectionString:dbUrl});try{if(action==='log'){const mood=input.mood||'neutral';const score=input.score??5;const note=input.note||'';const energy=input.energy??null;await pool.query(`INSERT INTO user_data_schema.mood_logs (user_id, mood, score, energy, note, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW())`,[userId,mood,score,energy,note]);await pool.end();return{json:{success:true,mood,score,energy,message:`Mood logged: ${mood} (${score}/10)`}};}else if(action==='history'){const days=input.days||7;const result=await pool.query(`SELECT mood, score, energy, note, created_at FROM user_data_schema.mood_logs WHERE user_id = $1 AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '${days} days' ORDER BY created_at DESC`,[userId]);await pool.end();return{json:{logs:result.rows,count:result.rows.length,days}};}else if(action==='summary'){const result=await pool.query(`SELECT mood, COUNT(*) as freq, AVG(score)::NUMERIC(3,1) as avg_score FROM user_data_schema.mood_logs WHERE user_id = $1 AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY mood ORDER BY freq DESC`,[userId]);await pool.end();return{json:{summary:result.rows,period:'30 days'}};}await pool.end();return{json:{error:'Unknown action. Use: log | history | summary'}};}catch(err){try{await pool.end();}catch(e){}return{json:{error:`${i18n.error||'Error'}: ${err.message}`}};}

parameters.name: growth_reflection
parameters.description: Reflect on personal growth, goals, and values. Actions: reflect, set_goal (requires: goal; optional: category, target_date), review_goals, values.
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const action=(input.action||'reflect').toLowerCase();const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const creds=ctx.credentials||{};const i18n=ctx.i18n||{};const userId=ctx.userId;const dbUrl=creds.database_url||'';const persona=ctx._persona||{};const ethicalProfile=persona.ethical_profile||{};if(!dbUrl)return{json:{error:i18n.db_not_configured||'Database not configured'}};const{Pool}=require('pg');const pool=new Pool({connectionString:dbUrl});try{if(action==='set_goal'){const goal=input.goal||'';const category=input.category||'personal';const targetDate=input.target_date||null;if(!goal)return{json:{error:'Goal description required'}};await pool.query(`INSERT INTO user_data_schema.growth_goals (user_id, goal, category, target_date, status, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'active', NOW())`,[userId,goal,category,targetDate]);await pool.end();return{json:{success:true,goal,category,message:`Goal set: "${goal}"`}};}else if(action==='review_goals'){const result=await pool.query(`SELECT id, goal, category, target_date, status, progress_note, created_at FROM user_data_schema.growth_goals WHERE user_id = $1 AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC`,[userId]);await pool.end();return{json:{goals:result.rows,count:result.rows.length}};}else if(action==='values'){await pool.end();return{json:{growth_stage:ethicalProfile.growth_stage||'exploring',growth_stage_label:ethicalProfile.growth_stage_label||'',top_strengths:ethicalProfile.top_strengths||[],core_values:ethicalProfile.core_values||[],communication_style:ethicalProfile.communication_style||'balanced',life_priorities:ethicalProfile.life_priorities||[],message:'Ethical profile retrieved from persona'}};}else{const stage=ethicalProfile.growth_stage||2;const prompts={1:'อะไรที่ทำให้คุณรู้สึกมีชีวิตชีวาในช่วงนี้?',2:'คุณสังเกตเห็นรูปแบบอะไรในการตอบสนองต่อความท้าทายของตัวเองไหม?',3:'การกระทำของคุณสอดคล้องกับสิ่งที่คุณให้คุณค่าแค่ไหน?',4:'คุณกำลังช่วยใครเติบโต และคุณเรียนรู้อะไรจากพวกเขา?',5:'มรดกที่คุณอยากฝากไว้คืออะไร?'};await pool.end();return{json:{growth_stage:stage,reflection_prompt:prompts[stage]||prompts[2]}};};}catch(err){try{await pool.end();}catch(e){}return{json:{error:`${i18n.error||'Error'}: ${err.message}`}};}

parameters.name: relationship_insights
parameters.description: Analyze relationship patterns and interpersonal dynamics. Actions: insights, log_interaction (requires: person, type; optional: feeling, note), patterns.
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const creds=ctx.credentials||{};const i18n=ctx.i18n||{};const userId=ctx.userId;const dbUrl=creds.database_url||'';const action=(input.action||'insights').toLowerCase();if(!dbUrl)return{json:{error:i18n.db_not_configured||'Database not configured'}};const{Pool}=require('pg');const pool=new Pool({connectionString:dbUrl});try{if(action==='log_interaction'){const person=input.person||'';const type=input.type||'conversation';const feeling=input.feeling||'';const note=input.note||'';await pool.query(`INSERT INTO user_data_schema.relationship_logs (user_id, person_name, interaction_type, feeling, note, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW())`,[userId,person,type,feeling,note]);await pool.end();return{json:{success:true,message:`Interaction with ${person} logged`}};}else if(action==='patterns'){const result=await pool.query(`SELECT person_name, COUNT(*) as interactions, array_agg(DISTINCT interaction_type) as types FROM user_data_schema.relationship_logs WHERE user_id = $1 AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY person_name ORDER BY interactions DESC LIMIT 10`,[userId]);await pool.end();return{json:{patterns:result.rows,period:'30 days'}};}else{await pool.end();return{json:{message:'Describe the situation and I will help reflect on patterns and perspectives.',tip:'Log interactions over time with log_interaction for pattern analysis'}};};}catch(err){try{await pool.end();}catch(e){}return{json:{error:`${i18n.error||'Error'}: ${err.message}`}};}

parameters.name: manage_habits
parameters.description: Log a completed habit or view habit streaks. Actions: log_habit (requires: habit_name; optional: completed bool, notes), view_streaks.
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const creds=ctx.credentials||{};const i18n=ctx.i18n||{};const userId=ctx.userId;const dbUrl=creds.database_url||'';const action=(input.action||'view_streaks').toLowerCase();if(!dbUrl)return{json:{error:i18n.db_not_configured||'Database not configured'}};const{Pool}=require('pg');const pool=new Pool({connectionString:dbUrl});try{if(action==='log_habit'){const name=input.habit_name||'';const completed=input.completed!==false;const notes=input.notes||'';if(!name)return{json:{error:i18n.habit_name_required||'habit_name is required'}};const result=await pool.query(`INSERT INTO user_data_schema.habit_log (user_id, habit_name, completed, notes, logged_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW()) RETURNING id`,[userId,name,completed,notes]);await pool.end();return{json:{success:true,message:i18n.success,habit:name,completed,id:result.rows[0]?.id}};}else{const result=await pool.query(`SELECT habit_name, COUNT(*) as streak, MAX(logged_at) as last_done FROM user_data_schema.habit_log WHERE user_id = $1 AND logged_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND completed = true GROUP BY habit_name ORDER BY streak DESC`,[userId]);await pool.end();return{json:{habits:result.rows,count:result.rows.length}};};}catch(err){try{await pool.end();}catch(e){}return{json:{error:`${i18n.error||'Error'}: ${err.message}`}};}

parameters.name: manage_persona
parameters.description: Read or update user personality profile and preferences. Actions: read_profile, update_profile (requires: updates object).
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const creds=ctx.credentials||{};const i18n=ctx.i18n||{};const userId=ctx.userId;const dbUrl=creds.database_url||'';const action=(input.action||'read_profile').toLowerCase();if(!dbUrl)return{json:{error:i18n.db_not_configured||'Database not configured'}};const{Pool}=require('pg');const pool=new Pool({connectionString:dbUrl});try{if(action==='read_profile'){const result=await pool.query(`SELECT display_name, language_preference, timezone, preferences, physical_stats FROM user_data_schema.user_profiles WHERE user_id = $1 LIMIT 1`,[userId]);await pool.end();return{json:{profile:result.rows[0]||{},found:result.rows.length>0}};}else if(action==='update_profile'){const updates=input.updates||{};if(Object.keys(updates).length===0)return{json:{error:i18n.no_updates||'No updates provided'}};const result=await pool.query(`UPDATE user_data_schema.user_profiles SET preferences = COALESCE(preferences,'{}')::jsonb || $1::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = $2 RETURNING user_id, preferences`,[JSON.stringify(updates),userId]);await pool.end();return{json:{success:true,message:i18n.success,updated:result.rows[0]?.preferences||{}}};}await pool.end();return{json:{error:'Unknown action. Use: read_profile | update_profile'}};}catch(err){try{await pool.end();}catch(e){}return{json:{error:`${i18n.error||'Error'}: ${err.message}`}};}

parameters.name: mindfulness_guide
parameters.description: Get a step-by-step mindfulness or breathing exercise guide. Exercises: box_breathing, four_seven_eight, loving_kindness, body_scan.
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const lang=ctx.lang||'th';const ex=(input.exercise||'box_breathing').toLowerCase().replace(/[- ]/g,'_');const guidesI18n={box_breathing:{name:{th:'Box Breathing 4-4-4-4 (หายใจกล่อง)',en:'Box Breathing 4-4-4-4',ja:'ボックス呼吸法 4-4-4-4',zh:'方块呼吸法 4-4-4-4'},steps:{th:['หายใจเข้าช้าๆ นับ 1-2-3-4','กลั้นลมหายใจ นับ 1-2-3-4','หายใจออกช้าๆ นับ 1-2-3-4','พักก่อนหายใจใหม่ นับ 1-2-3-4'],en:['Inhale slowly, count 1-2-3-4','Hold your ทำให้ระบบประสาทสงบ',en:'Reduces stress and calms the nervous system',ja:'ストレスを軽減し、神経系を落ち着かせる',zh:'减轻压力，平静神经系统'},duration_min:5,rounds:4},four_seven_eight:{name:{th:'4-7-8 Breathing May I be happy, May I be healthy, May I be safe','Think of someone you love, send them good wishes','Expand to acquaintances, strangers, and all beings','End with deep breaths and slowly open your eyes'],ja:['楽に座り、目を閉じ、深呼吸を3回する','自分自身を思い浮かべ、心の中で言う：私が幸せでありますように','愛する人を思い浮かべ、善意を送る','知人、見知らぬ人、すべての生き物に広げる','深呼吸でしめくくり、ゆっくりと目を開ける'],zh:['舒适地坐好，闭上眼睛，深呼吸3次','想到自己，在心里说：愿我快乐，愿我健康，愿我平安','想到你爱的人，向他们送去祝福','扩展到熟人、陌生人和所有众生','以深呼吸结束，慢慢睁开眼睛']},benefit:{th:'เพิ่มความเมตตา ขยับขึ้น','ถึงส่วนไหนที่ตึงหรือเจ็บปวด — แค่รับรู้ ไม่ต้องแก้','จบที่ศีรษะ หายใจลึก แล้วค่อยๆ ลืมตา'],en:['Lie on your back or sit comfortably, close your eyes','Observe your breath for 5 cycles, no
